reason: Quote is real and Jumpr accepted the ask (Kobi: 'We can do that'). No WAGR ticket gives Deals an 'Active' default or pinned working list view. But the claim is weaker than stated: (1) WAGR-307 (Done) already built an 'Active Deals by Partner' list view in the POC; (2) Inactive later became an automated, informational, self-reactivating status (WAGR-506, WAGR-487, L3406, L3310), so 'exclude Inactive' is no longer obviously right; 'old' deals now map to Closed/Archived; (3) the import of legacy inactive deals that caused the ask was parked (L1627); (4) Salesforce cannot set a default list for all users (L2916), so the fix is one list view plus a pin step at onboarding (L2918). This is a small config gap (XXS), not Medium.
q1: Found, with minor filler differences. Re-fetched doc 1Qw_rUiBDniWRNlPQ1St7C7VbJ5rCPriZCrMoUeCHGV8 ('Wagertech <> Jumpr: Weekly Sync - 2026/08/11'). Quote segments are at lines 273-287 of the fetched text, timestamp 00:12:35 to 00:13:26. The ellipses drop only intervening lines (Kobi: 'Yeah. Yeah, we could we could do that.', Joyce: 'inactive', Kobi: 'inactive ... might still be helpful to see inactive ones ... obviously not in like any working list ... for those really old ones ... we can add another status'). Kobi's final words span two lines: 'We can do' / 'that.'. Joyce's 'default' continues as 'view.' on the next line. Wording is not changed.
q2: Supports the claim in context. Just before the quote, Joyce agreed to import all inactive deals and operators 'if we can in the UI just make sure that they're like either hidden or like in a separate tab so that the user just doesn't have to scroll'. Kobi said 'That makes sense' and offered a status. Joyce left the mechanism to Jumpr ('whatever you think is the best in terms of engineering the structure. I just don't want it to clutter kind of the default view'). Kobi said 'We can do that.' The Gemini summary records it as agreed ('the team agreed to implement an "inactive" status for older deals ... hide legacy deals from active working lists'). Nuances: (a) Kobi himself said Inactive deals could stay visible but not in working lists, and suggested a separate status for 'really old ones'; (b) Joyce's ask also covered operators ('inactive deals and operators and stuff'), not only Deals; (c) the ask was conditional on importing legacy inactive deals.
q3: No later meeting reverses the requirement for Deals, but later items change what it means. L1627 (same meeting): overall migration scope was later parked until the CMS integration is final, so the legacy inactive deal import that caused this ask is uncertain. L2914/L2915 (2026-09-23): default 'All Active' list, sort newest first, keep 'All'. I checked raw transcript lines 405-470: this was for Sign-Up lists only (tracked in WAGR-423), not Deals. L2916/L2918 (2026-09-23): Salesforce opens on Recently Viewed for all users and this cannot be changed; users pin their list during onboarding. This limits what 'default view' can mean. L3310 (2026-09-29), L3406 (2026-09-30): Deal Inactive is informational, set automatically after 90 days with no signups, and goes back to Active when a signup comes in. L2498/L3404: a Retired status was added and renamed Archived. So 'hide old deals' now maps to Closed/Archived, not to Inactive.
q4: Partly covered. JQL runs: text~'inactive' (50+ hits, page 1 checked), text~'list view' (all 85 checked), and text~('"All Active"' OR clutter OR '"working list"' OR '"Active Deals"' OR pin) (20 hits). None asks for a Deal working list or pinned list that hides Inactive/Closed/Archived deals. WAGR-61 (Ready, Kobi, Phase 1, 0 comments): Deal list view columns only, no filter. WAGR-480 (Open, Taryn, 0 comments): makes Recently Viewed columns match 'All' and keeps 'All' unchanged. WAGR-506 (Jumpr Review, Cedrick, 1 comment): status values only; says Inactive is informational. WAGR-487 (Requirements, unassigned, 0 comments): 90-day automation, no list views. WAGR-270 (Done): Sign-Up list views only. WAGR-423: the Sign-Up 'All Active' pattern, not for Deals. WAGR-307 (Done, POC-14, 0 comments) already built an 'Active Deals by Partner' list view. This partly covers the need, but it predates the Inactive/Closed/Archived values and is not the pinned working view. The claim's nearest_considered list included WAGR-307 but what_differs did not mention it.
corrections: Add WAGR-307 to what_differs: an 'Active Deals by Partner' list view already exists from POC-14 (Done). The gap is updating or confirming it as the Ops working list after the new status set, plus an onboarding pin step. It is not a brand-new view.

Suggested action: exclude Closed and Archived (and possibly Draft) from the working list. Do not exclude Inactive by default. Inactive is now automated, informational and goes back to Active when a signup comes in (WAGR-506, WAGR-487, L3406). Kobi said on 2026-08-11 that Inactive ones may still be useful to see. Confirm with the client whether Inactive goes in the working list.
'Default view' cannot be set org-wide in Salesforce (L2916, 2026-09-23). Write the AC as a pinned 'Active Deals' list plus an onboarding step (L2918), following the WAGR-423 Sign-Up pattern.
Scope note: Joyce's ask covered inactive operators as well as deals ('inactive deals and operators and stuff'). The trigger (legacy inactive deal import) was parked per L1627.
Severity Medium -> Low: small list view config item with an existing partial view. Low client-visible risk if done at onboarding.
